There has been a sudden surge in the movement of gas tankers along Creek Road, inward NAVGAS, as they queue to load gas. However, our personnel have successfully organized and streamlined the tankers into a single lane along both Creek Road and Warehouse Road.
Traffic flow in the area remains under control, and normal movement is being maintained.
